{{Current events|year=2026|month=02|day=22|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[2026 Jalisco operation]]
***[[Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes|Nemesio "El Mencho" Oseguera]], leader of the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] (CJNG), and six other gunmen are killed during a security operation carried out by the [[Mexican Armed Forces]] near [[Tapalpa]], [[Jalisco]]. In response, CJNG members launched coordinated retaliatory attacks, including road blockades involving burning vehicles and improvised checkpoints across multiple states. [https://www.nmas.com.mx/nacional/fuentes-federales-confirman-a-n-la-muerte-de-nemesio-oseguera-cervantes-alias-el-mencho/ (N+)] [https://apnews.com/article/jalisco-cartel-drugs-mexico-mencho-new-generation-5014a70bc62a81d74849146c59ba19f8 (AP)]
***At least seven [[National Guard (Mexico)|National Guard]] troops are killed in clashes with CJNG forces in Western Mexico. [https://apnews.com/article/jalisco-cartel-drugs-mexico-mencho-new-generation-5014a70bc62a81d74849146c59ba19f8 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[79th British Academy Film Awards]]
**At the 2026 [[BAFTA Awards]], the [[Cinema of the United States|American film]] ''[[One Battle After Another]]'' wins the most awards with six, including [[BAFTA Award for Best Film|Best Film]]. ''[[Hamnet (film)|Hamnet]]'' became the most-nominated film by a female director and ''[[Sinners (2025 film)|Sinners]]'' became the most-nominated film by a Black director in BAFTA history. [https://apnews.com/article/bafta-film-awards-sinners-hamnet-15651cec9d900fff5e8347ffbec3b608 (AP)] [https://rollingout.com/2026/01/28/ryan-coogler-makes-bafta-history/ (''Rolling Out'')] [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/chloe-zhao-hamnet-bafta-most-nominated-film-female-director-1236485900/ (''The Hollywood Reporter'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[February 2026 North American blizzard]]
**In the [[United States]], a major [[nor'easter]] [[snowstorm]] hits the [[East Coast of the United States|East Coast]], causing [[blizzard]] conditions and major transportation disruptions. [https://www.cnn.com/weather/live-news/blizzard-snow-nyc-storm-forecast-02-22-26 (CNN)]
*[[Search and rescue]] operations begin for three individuals who have been reported missing after a collapse of a [[landfill]] in [[Rodriguez, Rizal|Rodriguez]], [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]], [[Philippines]], two days prior. There are other claims that up to 50 people are feared missing from the incident. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/asia/50-feared-missing-after-another-philippines-landfill-collapse (''Khaleej Times'')] [https://mb.com.ph/2026/02/22/3-scavengers-feared-dead-as-landfill-collapses-in-rizal-ocd (''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Russia relations]]
**The ''[[Financial Times]]'' reports that [[Iran]] had signed a confidential [[Euro|€]]500 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]589 million) arms agreement with [[Russia]] in December 2025 to buy 500 [[9K333 Verba|9K333 ''Verba'']] [[man-portable air-defense system]]s and 2,500 associated missiles, with deliveries scheduled between 2027 and 2029 under a contract negotiated between [[Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics (Iran)|Iran's defence ministry]] and the [[Rosoboronexport]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-agreed-secret-shoulder-fired-missile-deal-with-russia-ft-reports-2026-02-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[United States Secret Service|Secret Service]] and police officials kill an armed 21-year-old man who entered [[Mar-a-Lago]], [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s estate in [[Palm Beach, Florida|Palm Beach]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cr57l3rj3yqt (BBC News)]
*A suspect is injured in a [[shootout]] with a [[United States Border Patrol]] agent near the [[Canada–United States border]] in [[Pittsburg, New Hampshire|Pittsburg]], [[New Hampshire]], United States. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] says they are investigating. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/article/fbi-investigate-shooting-at-canada-new-hampshire-border-crossing-suspect-hospitalized (CTV News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Laotian parliamentary election]]
**[[Laotians]] vote in a parliamentary election to elect the 175 members of the [[National Assembly of Laos|tenth National Assembly]]. The only legal party in [[Laos]] contesting the election is the [[Lao People's Revolutionary Party]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260220-outspoken-laos-lawmaker-s-election-exit-sparks-rare-dissent (AFP via France 24)]
*[[9th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea]]
**[[North Korea]]'s [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|supreme leader]], [[Kim Jong Un]], is re-elected as the [[General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea]], the most powerful position in the [[one-party state]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20260222-north-korea-kim-re-elected-ruling-party-congress (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Hernando de Soto (economist)|Hernando de Soto]] is (falsely) announced as the new [[Prime Minister of Peru|prime minister]] of [[Peru]]. [https://gestion.pe/peru/politica/hernando-de-soto-sera-el-presidente-del-consejo-de-ministros-noticia/ (''Gestión'' <small>in Spanish</small>)]. Two days later [[Denisse Miralles]] is sworn in to this office.

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Winter Olympics]]
** [[2026 Winter Olympics closing ceremony]]
*** The [[Winter Olympics]] conclude with [[Norway at the 2026 Winter Olympics|Norway]] as the highest-ranked team in the [[2026 Winter Olympics medal table|medal table]]. The [[Olympic flag]] is handed over to the organizers of the [[2030 Winter Olympics]] to be held in the [[French Alps]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/sport/20260222-milan-cortina-hands-over-flag-to-french-alps-for-2030-winter-olympics (France 24)]
**[[Ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Olympics]]
***The [[United States men's national ice hockey team|United States]] defeats [[Canada men's national ice hockey team|Canada]] 2–1 during [[Overtime (ice hockey)|overtime]], winning gold in the [[Ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Men's tournament|men's tournament]] in [[ice hockey]] for the first time since [[Ice hockey at the 1980 Winter Olympics|1980]], exactly 46 years after the [[Miracle on Ice]]. [https://www.nbclosangeles.com/olympics/2026-milan-cortina/team-usa-canada-mens-hockey-gold-medal-game/3851942/ (KNBC-TV)]
